title: ControllerConfig
description: Startup configuration for the Agentdesktop fleet controller.

adminListener.description: Listener for the controller management UI and API.

allowInsecureDev.description:
Permit a non-HTTPS OIDC issuer for isolated local development.

This escape hatch is only appropriate for isolated local development.

daemonConfig.description: Daemon configuration distributed to enrolled devices.

databaseUrl.description: SQLite or PostgreSQL URL used for controller state.

enrollmentTokens.description: Unattended device enrollment with operator-signed tokens. Disabled when unset.

fleetListener.description: Listener for the device-facing gRPC fleet API.

gatewayListener.description:
Listener that LLM gateways use, started when `gatewayJwt` is set. It serves only `/.well-known/jwks.json`, the keys gateways use to verify controller-issued JWTs.

No other listener serves the keys, so a NetworkPolicy or firewall can allow gateways this port and block the management API, which can read the device inventory and delete devices. Gateways that export usage also need the fleet port.

oidc.description: OpenID Connect settings used for device enrollment and authorization.

tls.description:
TLS identities used by the device-facing fleet API.

A string selects a directory containing `controller.pem`,
`controller-key.pem`, `device-ca.pem`, and `device-ca-key.pem`.

usage.description: Token and cost collection from agentgateway access logs.

ControllerAdminAccess.description: Authentication and exposure policy for the management API and UI.

oneOf.description: Unauthenticated access restricted to an IPv4 or IPv6 loopback listener.

Remote management through a compiled-in authentication extension. The standard
controller has no such extension and rejects this mode at startup.

provider.description:
Settings owned and validated by the compiled-in authentication extension.
Relative paths inside it are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

publicUrl.description: Exact external HTTPS origin, without a path other than `/`.

transport.description: How HTTPS reaches the management listener.

ControllerAdminLimitsConfig.description:
Connection limits on the management listener. Any connection can be closed
to make room at a limit, including one with a request in progress. Unset
fields keep their defaults.

connectionsPerAddress.description: Open management connections allowed from one client address: an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /64. At the limit, that address's connection idle the longest is closed to admit a new one. Defaults to `256`, the same as `maxConnections`, because behind a proxy or on loopback every connection has the same address.

maxConnections.description: Open management connections allowed in total. At the limit, the connection idle the longest is closed to admit a new one. Defaults to `256`.

ControllerAdminListener.description: Listener for the controller management UI and API.

access.description: Management authentication, separate from device enrollment. Defaults to local-only access.

limits.description: Connection limits on the management listener.

listen.description: Address on which the management listener accepts connections. Defaults to `127.0.0.1:8080`. Local access requires a loopback address.

oneOf.description: HTTPS terminates at a trusted proxy; the plaintext listener must not be public.
The management listener terminates TLS directly.

certificate.description: PEM certificate chain. Relative paths are resolved from the configuration directory.

key.description: PEM private key. Relative paths are resolved from the configuration directory.

ControllerDaemonConfig.description: Controller-owned daemon configuration file and its revision.

path.description:
Path to the watched YAML configuration distributed to enrolled devices.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.
Valid file changes are published to connected devices automatically.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision assigned to the daemon configuration.

name.description: Issuer (`iss`) of the tokens this key verifies.

publicKeyPath.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded public key: ECDSA P-256 (ES256), Ed25519 (EdDSA)
or RSA (RS256).

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

revokedIds.description:
Token IDs (`jti`) that are no longer accepted. Devices enrolled with
one of them are rejected as well.

ControllerEnrollmentTokensConfig.description:
Enrollment tokens are JWTs with `iss`, `aud`, `jti` and `iat` claims; `exp`
and `nbf` are honored when present. A token enrolls any number of devices.

audience.description: Audience (`aud`) every enrollment token must carry.

ControllerFleetLimitsConfig.description:
Limits on the device-facing fleet API that depend on the deployment: how
many devices connect, how many share one client address, and how much they
send. Unset fields keep their defaults.

connectionsPerAddress.description:
Open fleet connections allowed from one client address: an IPv4
address, or an IPv6 /64. At the limit, that address's idle connection
with the oldest activity is closed to admit a new one; when none is
idle, the new one is closed. Raise it when more devices share an address, such as behind a
NAT or a load balancer that does not preserve client addresses. Defaults
to `4096`.

deviceMessageBurst.description:
Messages one device may send in a burst on its `Connect` stream, after
which it may send one more every `deviceMessageRefill`. Once a device
has sent its burst, the controller reads its messages no faster than
that, and the device waits to send more. Defaults to `600`.

deviceMessageRefill.description: Time for a device to get back one message. Defaults to `50ms`.

enrollmentBurst.description:
Enrollment requests one client address may make in a burst, after which
it may make one more every `enrollmentRefill`. Each device sign-in makes
at least two: one to read the login configuration and one to enroll.
Defaults to `60`.

enrollmentInFlight.description:
Enrollment requests in progress at once across all clients. Enrollment
calls the identity provider. Defaults to `64`.

enrollmentRefill.description:
Time for a client address to get back one enrollment request. Defaults
to `1s`.

maxConnections.description:
Open fleet connections allowed in total. At the limit, the idle
connection with the oldest activity (its last request starting or
ending, or else its being accepted) is closed to admit a new one; when
none is idle, the new one is closed. A connection is idle unless a
client with a device certificate has a request or `Connect` stream open
on it. Defaults to `50000`.

maxMessageBytes.description:
Largest message, in bytes, that a device and the controller may send
each other. Requests from clients without a device certificate, such as
enrollment, stay limited to 64 KiB. Devices accept at most 4 MiB, so
raising this only raises what devices may send. Defaults to `4194304`
(4 MiB).

ControllerFleetListener.description: Listener for the device-facing gRPC fleet API.

limits.description: Limits on the fleet API that depend on the deployment.

listen.description: Address on which the fleet listener accepts connections. Defaults to `127.0.0.1:8443`; devices on other hosts need a non-loopback address.

ControllerGatewayJwtConfig.description: Settings for issuing short-lived LLM gateway JWTs.

issuer.description: Issuer claim placed in generated JWTs.

keyId.description: Key identifier placed in generated JWT headers.

lifetime.description: Lifetime of generated JWTs. Defaults to `5m`.

privateKey.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded RSA private signing key.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

ControllerGatewayLimitsConfig.description:
Connection limits on the gateway listener. Any connection can be closed to
make room at a limit, including one with a request in progress. Unset fields
keep their defaults.

connectionsPerAddress.description: Open gateway connections allowed from one client address: an IPv4 address, or an IPv6 /64. At the limit, that address's connection idle the longest is closed to admit a new one. Raise it when many gateway replicas share an address. Defaults to `64`.

maxConnections.description: Open gateway connections allowed in total. At the limit, the connection idle the longest is closed to admit a new one. Defaults to `1024`.

ControllerGatewayListener.description: Listener for LLM gateways, separate from the fleet API and the management UI.

limits.description: Connection limits on the gateway listener.

listen.description: Address on which the gateway listener accepts connections. Defaults to `127.0.0.1:8444`.

tls.description: Serve HTTPS with the controller certificate from `tls` instead of plain HTTP. Use HTTPS unless gateways reach the listener over loopback or a trusted network: whoever can change the keys a gateway fetches can forge credentials it accepts.

ControllerOidcConfig.description: OpenID Connect settings used for interactive device enrollment.

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI registered for the native enrollment client.

ControllerTlsConfig.description: TLS configuration for the fleet API and device certificate issuer.

anyOf.description: Directory containing the four standard TLS files.
Explicit paths to each TLS file.

ControllerTlsFiles.description: Explicit TLS file paths for the fleet API and device certificate issuer.

certificate.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded TLS certificate chain.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

clientCaCertificate.description: PEM CA roots used to verify issued device client certificates.

clientCaKey.description:
PEM private key used to issue device certificates from `clientCaCertificate`.

Enrolled daemons generate their own private key and send a CSR.

key.description:
Path to the PEM-encoded TLS private key.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.

ControllerUsageConfig.description:
Collection of LLM token and cost records that agentgateway exports to the
fleet API as OTLP access logs over gRPC.

tokenFile.description:
Path to a file containing the bearer token agentgateway sends with each export. The token must be at least 32 characters.

Relative paths are resolved from the controller configuration directory.
